column1: Lytton is a wonderful place, but its not known for its fabulous-tasting water.
column2: 萊頓是個美好的地方，但這裡的水並不好喝。

column1: Here I sit all broken-hearted... Came to........(you can't make out the rest).
column2: 我坐在這裡心碎欲絕……來到……（後面的字看不清楚）。

column1: Nostalgia just isn't what it used to be.
column2: 懷舊之情已不復從前。

column1: For a good time, call 683-4463....ask for Larry.
column2: 想找樂子，請撥 683-4463……找拉瑞。

column1: There's a fairly good anatomical drawing here, but it appears to be upside-down.
column2: 這裡有一幅畫得不錯的人體解剖圖，但似乎上下顛倒了。

column1: Where the hell is Coarsegold, CA???
column2: 科斯戈爾德，加州，到底在哪裡？？？

column1: As I was walking down the stair I met a man who wasn't there. He wasn't there again today... I sure do wish he'd GO AWAY!
column2: 我走下樓梯時遇見一個不在那裡的人。今天他又不在那裡……真希望他快點滾開！

column1: What? Where?
column2: 什麼？哪裡？

column1: Defacing public property isn't part of your job description.
column2: 破壞公共財產不在你的職務內容裡。

column1: You hum a familiar tune..."Plop, plop, whiz, whiz....oh, what a relief it is."
column2: 你哼著熟悉的曲調……「撲通、撲通、嘶、嘶……啊，真舒暢。」

column1: During this time of relief, you think to yourself... "Gee, wish I had something to read."
column2: 在這段舒暢時光裡，你心想……「真希望有東西可以讀。」

column1: As you occupy the stall you think, "It must have been the prunes."
column2: 你坐在隔間裡，心想：「一定是梅乾。」

column1: On the floor? Better go into a stall first.
column2: 在地板上？最好先進隔間。

column1: Whew! you sigh, "I need to quit drinking so much coffee."
column2: 「呼！」你嘆氣，「我得少喝一點咖啡。」

column1: You take time out for a natural body function.
column2: 你停下來處理生理需求。

column1: You rid yourself of enough coffee to float an aircraft carrier.
column2: 你排出的咖啡多到足以讓航空母艦漂浮。

column1: As you eliminate the day's coffee, you think..."I wonder where the "black" in my black coffee goes?"
column2: 排出今天喝的咖啡時，你心想……「不知道黑咖啡裡的『黑』都跑去哪裡了？」

column1: Of course!
column2: 當然！

column1: You should be in one of the stalls to do that.
column2: 你應該進入其中一間隔間再做那件事。

column1: Now's no time to relax, Sonny.
column2: 現在不是放鬆的時候，桑尼。

column1: There's no place to sit, unless you go into one of the toilet stalls.
column2: 沒有地方可坐，除非你進入廁所隔間。

column1: You look all around the toilet and the stall, but you find nothing out of the ordinary.
column2: 你仔細查看馬桶與隔間，但沒找到任何異常。

column1: Go ahead and enter one of the stalls.
column2: 進入其中一間隔間吧。

column1: You search high and low, but so far you've found nothing.
column2: 你到處搜索，但目前仍一無所獲。

column1: He doesn't seem to hear you. He's humming under his breath..."Leeeavinn'...on a jet plane..."
column2: 他似乎沒聽見你。他低聲哼著……「離——開……搭上飛機……」
